findings.where: column sub-labels 'Mathematical Reasoning', 'Software Engineering', 'Agent Task Completion'
findings.evidence: dom-1920.json: color #bbbbbb at 11px on white, about 1.9:1; the contrast detector reported no hit on this slide.
Value text #888888 at 15px sits on a light grey bar (~#e0e0e0), about 2.6:1; labels #888 on white are 3.5:1 at 13px.
findings.after: Value text #444 on the grey bar (>= 4.5:1); labels #555
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum); the comparison series is the least readable.

findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.3; the only sourcing on the slide must be legible.

findings.evidence: No headings or landmarks in dom-1920.json (main:0); 'GLM-4.7' and benchmark names are divs, so an exported PDF or screen reader gets no reading structure; reading order puts the top-bar label before the model name.
findings.after: <h1> for the slide title, <h2> per benchmark column; tagged PDF on export

strengths: Red/black/grey bar encoding also differs in lightness, so the subject still stands out in grayscale (T-GRAYSCALE passes); every value is printed on its bar.
